title: 第一卷 第116章 是陈天要对付我们？
slug: 重生1989我一赌鬼带全家顿顿吃肉

第(1/3)页

听到王建军的开导，郝大能深吸了几口气，一下子想明白了许多，心情也不像刚才那么消沉了。

是啊，早在一开始，王建军便跟他说过这话。

只不过那个时候，他满脑子都想着能挣钱就成，根本没往深处去想。

后来看见他们百味鲜虾馆，一天能挣这么多钱，他更是被冲昏了头脑。

到现在不过是少挣了一两千，他就沉不住气。

“怪我，怪我这心态没调整好，让王兄弟你看笑话了。”

“也是，时间长着呢，慢慢来，一口吃不成胖子。”

郝大能说完，也想明白了些，心里也跟着松快了许多。

要不然以后的日子，他只会更加煎熬。

不纠结这事了，郝大能倒是想起了一件正事，神色一下子严肃了起来，急忙说道。

“王兄弟，你来的正好，我有事要跟你说，那些散布谣言的人找到了。”

听到这，王建军眼前一亮，神色也不由得激动了几分。

他虽然表面上看起来不在乎，但这百味鲜虾馆，可是他如今唯一挣钱的路径，不像郝大能镇上还有饭馆。

而且他处处都是花钱的地方。

别提几个月后，他还要攒钱去买地皮开商场，他的压力要比郝大能重得多。

只不过王建军向来喜欢把事藏在心里，不显山不露水罢了。

“怎么回事，那伙人到底是谁派来的？看到背后人是谁了吗？”

原本这事是郝大能提起的，但真说到这，郝大能反而有点不敢说了，神色也变得十分纠结。

看到他这样子，王建军心中就有一种不祥的预感，甚至隐隐有些猜测。

要么这人，郝大能认识。

要么就是这人来头很大，不是他们能得罪的。

无论是哪一种，对于眼下的他们来说，都不是什么好事。

“郝大哥，到底怎么了？”

“有什么事，你就直接说出来，要是对方真来头很大，或者这事难办，咱们再想别的办法。”

见王建军都这么说了，郝大能也知道自己瞒不下去了，无奈的叹了口气。

就连他自己都有点不敢置信的说道。

“我派去跟踪那些谣言的人说，他们亲眼看见那些人进了一个小巷子，紧接着又进了一个门牌号是188的房子。”

Page (1/3)

After hearing Wang Jianjun's enlightenment, Hao Daneng took a few deep breaths and suddenly understood a lot, and his mood was not as depressed as before.

Yes, Wang Jianjun told him this as early as the beginning.

But at that time, all he could think about was making money, and he didn't think deeply about it at all.

Later, when he saw that their Baiwei Shrimp Restaurant could earn so much money in a day, he was even more dazzled.

So far, he has only earned one or two thousand less, and he can't calm down.

"Blame me. Blame me for not adjusting my mentality properly. Brother Wang, you are laughing at me."

"Yes, it will take a long time. Take your time. You won't become fat after one bite."

After Hao Daneng finished speaking, he understood a little more and felt much more relaxed.

Otherwise, he will only suffer more in the days to come.

No longer entangled in this matter, Hao Daneng remembered something serious, his expression suddenly became serious, and he said hurriedly.

"Brother Wang, you came just in time. I have something to tell you. Those who spread rumors have been found."

Hearing this, Wang Jianjun's eyes lit up, and he couldn't help but look a little excited.

Although he doesn't seem to care on the surface, this Baiwei Shrimp Restaurant is his only way to make money now. Unlike Hao Daneng, there are restaurants in town.

And he spends money everywhere.

Not to mention that in a few months, he would have to save money to buy land and open a shopping mall. He would be under much more pressure than Hao Daneng.

It's just that Wang Jianjun always likes to hide things in his heart and not reveal the truth.

"What's going on? Who sent that group of people? Have you seen who is behind it?"

Originally it was Hao Daneng who brought up this matter, but when it came to this, Hao Daneng was a little afraid to say it, and his expression became very entangled.

Seeing him like this, Wang Jianjun had an ominous premonition in his heart, and even had some vague speculations.

Either Hao Daneng knows this person.

Either this person has a big background and is not something they can offend.

No matter which one it is, it is not a good thing for them at the moment.

"Brother Hao, what happened?"

"If you have any problem, just say it directly. If the other party is really powerful or the matter is difficult to handle, we will think of other ways."

Seeing that Wang Jianjun had said this, Hao Daneng also knew that he could no longer hide it, and sighed helplessly.

Even he himself said a little in disbelief.

"The people I sent to follow up on those rumors said that they saw those people entering an alley, and then entering a house with the house number 188."
